evidence.detail: Exact v308 recognizes @hov@/@shi@ plus <hover>, </hover>, <shift>, </shift>, <lift=N> and </lift> text controls.
The hover and shift states produce independent sinusoidal pixel offsets (amplitudes 2 and 3), while lift=N parses a signed vertical offset clamped to 40 pixels.
R55 RSFont applies the computed offsets to inline sprite/progress/image and glyph positions throughout the live render path.

When animated hover/shift text is rendered the class records a timestamp and exposes a 100 ms redraw-invalidating active state, proving it owns the motion effect lifecycle rather than simple markup recognition.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for hover/shift/lift text-position animation and offset markup.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 recognizes @glo@ plus numbered glow variants and matching glo markup, returning palette-family selectors from the text stream.
The class advances a phase from System.nanoTime on a fixed 40 ms cadence, combines character index with phase, and selects colors from precomputed 256-step palette tables.
R55 RSFont calls this class while parsing and drawing live text; returned colors feed per-character render color selection directly.
The implementation owns eight numbered 256-step glow palette families plus the default glow selector and contains no non-text behavior.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the glo markup color-cycling text effect.
